name: security-testing-suite

scripts.test-low: echo 'Running low severity tests...' && node low/sql_injection_basic.js && node low/auth_bypass_basic.js && node low/input_validation_basic.js

scripts.test-high: echo 'Running high severity tests...' && node high/oauth_jwt_exploit.js && node high/server_side_vulnerabilities.js && node high/advanced_auth_bypass.js
scripts.test-most-tight: echo 'Running most tight tests...' && node most_tight/zero_day_exploits.js && node most_tight/supply_chain_attack.js && node most_tight/comprehensive_penetration.js
